summary_md: **Peng ([@pengsonal](https://x.com/pengsonal/status/2116036171860230530))** points to NVIDIA's free **SimReady** dataset of ~2,700 3D assets with physical properties like weight and friction, suggesting you let a coding agent build scenes from them ([nvidia/simready-assets](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/simready-assets)).
relevance: Physics-ready 3D assets for agentic scene building.
